name: 04_restart_aborts_snapshot
description: A snapshot is in flight (channel n2->n1 pinned, markers not everywhere) when n1 is restarted. The recovery rule aborts s1 on n1: the run must NOT stitch pre- and post-restart state. t1 then drains as ordinary traffic; markers for s1 are refused with snapshot_interrupted and peers abort the same dead round. The whole round is restarted: n2 and n3 are also restarted and a fresh snapshot id s2 succeeds and conserves 300.

steps.note: restart while s1 is recording and t1 is in flight
starting the SAME id again is a state_conflict, not a continuation
t1 drains as ordinary traffic; the s1 marker behind it is refused and s1 aborts cluster-wide
restart the whole round: all processes that saw s1
